title: Mountable
summary: Turn your Cardputer into a dynamic and bootable USB or CD drive
description: Whenever you need to install an OS or boot a live CD, you need to image a USB drive (or burn a disk). With Mountable, you turn your Cardputer Zero into a bootable dynamic USB or CD-ROM drive with the image of your choice. Put your own images on the SD card or download through the provided list of OSes and disk images.
